name: Container
lead: A chest's stacks: `world.container(pos)`. A chest a player has open is theirs until it closes — `take` takes nothing, `put` puts nothing.

functions.name: take
functions.description: Up to `count` (1 unless you say) of what matches; how many it took.

functions.name: put
functions.description: How many did not fit; 0 when all of it went in.

fields.name: size
fields.description: How many slots the chest has, e.g. 27; 0 once it has gone.
